brands.title: Our Brands
brands.content: Ezmameats brings together two distinct international meat product brands, each with its own product range and market focus, backed by shared quality and food safety standards.

about-us.title: About Us
about-us.content:
Who We Are

Ezmameats is the international meat products division of Ezma Holding, bringing together trusted brands built on quality sourcing, rigorous processing, and export-ready reliability.

Our Brands

Ezmameats operates two distinct international brands:

  • Copacol — frozen chicken products, Halal certified and export-ready, available in retail and foodservice bulk packs.
  • Amber — frozen boneless buffalo meat, 14 premium export cuts, manufactured by Mirha Exports Pvt Ltd (New Delhi, India) and officially distributed in Iraq by Ezma FMCG.

Visit our Brands page for the full product range.

Quality & Certifications

Copacol products are inspected, assessed, and certified in full compliance with Shariah law and international Halal standards. Certified by Halal Certification Services Chongqing (HCS) to the Indonesian Halal Standard / GSO Halal Standard (GSO 2:2021-2055), recognized by BPJPH & GAC Accreditation Center. Every certificate is verifiable via QR code.

Amber buffalo meat is export quality certified and kept frozen from source through delivery.
